parts.title: Word List
parts.content:
Detailed Meanings

1
abbey[æbi]n.
An abbey is a house or group of houses where monks or nuns live.
→ When the monk returned to the abbey, he went immediately to his bedroom.
2
abundant[əbʌndənt]adj.
If something is abundant, then it is available in large quantities.
→ Cakes, cookies, and candy were so abundant that the child was very happy.
3
adjoin[ədʒɔin]v.
To adjoin something means to be next to or attached to something else.
→ She can listen to her brother’s conversations because her room adjoins his.
4
ample[æmpl]adj.
If something is ample, then it is enough or more than enough.
→ There was an ample supply of oats to feed the horses.
5
arid[ærid]adj.
If a place is arid, then it is hot and dry and gets very little or no rain.
→ Not many plants grow in the arid desert.
6
cathedral[kəθi:drəl]n.
A cathedral is an important and often large and beautifully built church.
→ The large cathedral is full of people on Sunday mornings.
7
deprive[dipraiv]v.
To deprive someone of something means to not let them have it.
→ Because the child was bad, she was deprived of her dessert after dinner.
8
drought[draut]n.
A drought is a long period of time in which little or no rain falls.
→ After three months of drought, the vegetation and trees started dying.
9
eligible[elidʒəbl]adj.
If someone is eligible, then they are permitted to do or have something.
→ Only people who bought tickets were eligible to win a prize.
10
fast[fæst]v.
To fast means to go without food or drink for a period of time.
→ In her religion, they fast for five days and then have a big feast.
11
grumble[grʌmbəl]v.
To grumble means to complain.
→ He grumbled about having to work late on Friday.
12
inland[inlənd]adv.
If someone goes inland, they travel into the center of a country or land.
→ The river curved inland near the campground.
13
moisture[mɔistʃər]n.
Moisture is small drops of water in the air or on a surface.
→ If you breathe on a window, moisture from your breath collects on the glass.
14
nonetheless[nʌnðəles]adv.
If something happens nonetheless, then it occurs despite some other thing.
→ She tried to keep the dog out of the mud, but it got dirty nonetheless.
15
oath[ouθ]n.
An oath is a formal, often public, promise.
→ Judges must take an oath to be fair to everyone in court.
16
prairie[preri]n.
A prairie is a large flat area of grassland.
→ The prairie was perfect for a farm because there were hills and trees.
17
ragged[rægid]adj.
If something is ragged, then it is old, torn, and falling apart.
→ They could see his toes through the holes in his ragged shoes.
18
rugged[rʌgid]adj.
If an area of land is rugged, then it is rocky and difficult to travel through.
→ Their car couldn’t make it far along the rugged roads.
19
scarce[skers]adj.
If something is scarce, then it is in a very small amount.
→ When gasoline was scarce, we rode our bikes, instead of driving, to school.
20
speculate[spekjəleit]v.
To speculate means to guess about something.
→ My sister looked at the sky and speculated that it would rain tomorrow.

sections.title: Exercise 1: Choose the answer that best fits the question.

questions.content: What would probably happen if you deprived someone of food?
questions.explanation: deprive là tước đoạt. Tước đoạt thức ăn có thể dẫn đến cái chết.

questions.content: A rugged surface would feel.
questions.explanation: rugged là gồ ghề. Bề mặt gồ ghề sẽ có cảm giác rất thô ráp (very rough).

questions.content: If you were speculating about something, you would be doing what?
questions.explanation: speculate là suy đoán. Suy đoán tức là đưa ra phỏng đoán (Making a guess).

questions.content: Where would someone take an oath?
questions.explanation: oath là lời thề. Người ta thường lập lời thề trước tòa án (In court).

questions.content: If something were covered with moisture, then it would feel.
questions.explanation: moisture là hơi ẩm. Bề mặt có hơi ẩm sẽ có cảm giác ướt (wet).

sections.title: Exercise 2: Fill in the blanks with the correct words.

questions.content: Traveling across the [ 6 ] was more difficult than it seemed.
questions.explanation: Đi ngang qua thảo nguyên (prairie) khó khăn hơn so với vẻ bề ngoài.

questions.content: The ground was very [ 7 ], and the grass was high.
questions.explanation: Mặt đất rất gồ ghề (rugged).

questions.content: John had been in a place with a(n) [ 8 ]climate for a long time.
questions.explanation: Nơi có khí hậu khô cằn (arid).

questions.content: He forgot that in a humid place everything was covered with [ 9 ].
questions.explanation: Nơi ẩm ướt mọi thứ được bao phủ bởi hơi ẩm (moisture).

questions.content: The people who attend that church [ 10 ]for two weeks in March.
questions.explanation: Người đến nhà thờ thường nhịn ăn (fast) trong hai tuần.

questions.content: Then they go to the [ 11 ]where they pray and eat a small meal of soup.
questions.explanation: Đến nhà thờ lớn (cathedral) để cầu nguyện.

questions.content: We didn’t know what to do with such a(n) [ 12 ]supply of wood.
questions.explanation: Nguồn cung cấp gỗ dồi dào (abundant).

questions.content: We had gotten used to making small fires when it was so [ 13 ].
questions.explanation: Quen với việc đốt lửa nhỏ khi gỗ khan hiếm (scarce).

questions.content: In order for the students to attend the dance, they had to take a(n) [ 14 ].
questions.explanation: Phải tuyên thệ/thề (take an oath) để tham gia.

questions.content: Those that didn’t promise to be on their best behavior were not [ 15 ].
questions.explanation: Những người không hứa hẹn sẽ không đủ điều kiện (eligible).

sections.title: Exercise 3: Write C if the italicized word is used correctly. Write I if the word is used incorrectly.

questions.content: Climbing up the prairie was more difficult without the help of ropes.
questions.explanation: prairie (thảo nguyên) là vùng đất bằng phẳng, không cần leo trèo bằng dây thừng.

questions.content: There was no way he could mend the holes in his shirt. It was too rugged to wear.
questions.explanation: rugged dùng cho địa hình gồ ghề. Quần áo rách phải dùng ragged.

questions.content: In some countries, only people who owned land were eligible to vote.
questions.explanation: eligible (đủ điều kiện). Đủ điều kiện để bỏ phiếu là cách dùng đúng.

questions.content: The capital was in the middle of the country. They had to travel inland to get there.
questions.explanation: inland (vào sâu trong đất liền). Đi vào đất liền để đến thủ đô là hợp lý.

questions.content: He knew she didn’t like him, but he helped her nonetheless.
questions.explanation: nonetheless (tuy nhiên, dù sao). Biết cô ấy không thích nhưng anh ta vẫn giúp là đúng.

sections.title: Exercise 4: Write a word that is similar in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.content:
That part of the country is so hot and dry that no one lives there. [ 21 ]

After getting off the boat, they took a train toward the center of the country. [ 22 ]

They survived through the time in which no rain fell by carrying water down from the hills. [ 23 ]

This house for the monks was built well over 200 years ago. [ 24 ]

He knew he’d get in trouble, but he stole the money despite the punishment. [ 25 ]

He guessed that the visitor’s team would win the game. [ 26 ]

The number of people helping to clean the trash near the river was more than enough. [ 27 ]

There was a small park that was next to the yard surrounding the church. [ 28 ]

Because his pants were old and torn. Dad bought him a new pair. [ 29 ]

The long lines did not allow her of a chance to buy a ticket for the concert. [ 30 ]
questions.explanation: hot and dry (nóng và khô) tương đương với arid (khô cằn).
toward the center of the country (vào trung tâm đất nước) tương đương inland.
time in which no rain fell (thời gian không có mưa) tương đương drought (hạn hán).
house for the monks (nhà cho các nhà sư) tương đương abbey (tu viện).
despite the punishment (bất chấp hình phạt) mang nghĩa mặc dù vậy, tương đương nonetheless.
guessed (đoán) tương đương speculated (suy đoán).
more than enough (nhiều hơn đủ) tương đương ample (dư dả).
next to (kế bên) tương đương adjoined (giáp ranh).
old and torn (cũ và rách) tương đương ragged.
did not allow (không cho phép/tước đi) tương đương deprived.

parts.title: Comprehensive Reading
parts.content:
The Helpful Abbey

It had not rained on the prairie for several months. Because of the drought, the climate had become very arid. There was no moisture left in the soil. No crops could grow in the dry ground. By wintertime, the people had nothing to eat.

The hungry families heard about an abbey near the mountains where food and water was still abundant. So they traveled inland, across the prairie, to the abbey.

At first only a few families arrived, seeking food and shelter. Then there was ample food. The monks fed them and let them sleep in the small cathedral.

Soon, however, more families were arriving every day. These people had to travel farther, so they were in worse condition. The rugged journey had made their clothes ragged. They were cold and tired. The tiny cathedral was soon full.

Food became scarce. The monks began to grumble. They began to speculate that there would be no food. “If more families come, we won’t make it through the winter,” said a young monk. “We must ask some of them to leave.”

The abbot heard this. “We cannot do that,” he said. “It would be wrong to deprive them of food and shelter. We took an oath to help those that need help. All here are in need, so all are eligible to receive our food and shelter.”

“But we won’t have enough,” the monk said.

“That might be true, but we must help them nonetheless. We will fast,” the abbot replied. “Also, we will give our rooms in the abbey to those sleeping outside, and we will sleep in the churchyard that adjoins the cathedral.”

The monks were reluctant at first, but they did what the oldest monk said. By the end of winter, there was still enough food and shelter for everyone. They learned that sometimes helping others means you must give more help than you first expected.

sections.title: Part A: Mark each statement True (T) or False (F).

questions.content: The moisture in the soil was gone because a drought made the prairie become arid.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Theo đoạn 1, "Because of the drought, the climate had become very arid. There was no moisture left in the soil." (Vì hạn hán, khí hậu trở nên rất khô cằn. Không còn hơi ẩm trong đất).

questions.content: The hungry families traveled inland to an abbey that still had abundant food.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Theo đoạn 2, "The hungry families heard about an abbey near the mountains where food and water was still abundant. So they traveled inland..." (Các gia đình đang đói nghe nói về một tu viện... nơi thức ăn và nước uống vẫn còn dồi dào. Vì vậy họ đi sâu vào đất liền...).

questions.content: Food was scarce, but the monks had to deprive the families nonetheless.
questions.explanation: Câu này sai. Theo đoạn 6 và 8, vị trụ trì nói "It would be wrong to deprive them of food and shelter... we must help them nonetheless." (Thật sai trái nếu tước đoạt thức ăn và nơi ở của họ... dù sao đi nữa chúng ta vẫn phải giúp họ).

questions.content: At first there was ample food and enough room in the cathedral for everyone.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Theo đoạn 3, "At first only a few families arrived... Then there was ample food. The monks fed them and let them sleep in the small cathedral." (Lúc đầu chỉ có một vài gia đình đến... Lúc đó có dư dả thức ăn. Các nhà sư cho họ ăn và ngủ trong nhà thờ nhỏ).

questions.content: The rugged journey to the abbey had left many people’s clothing looking ragged.
questions.explanation: Câu này đúng. Theo đoạn 4, "The rugged journey had made their clothes ragged." (Hành trình gồ ghề đã làm cho quần áo của họ trở nên rách rưới).

questions.content: According to the abbot, who was eligible to receive the monks’ help?
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 6, vị trụ trì khẳng định: "All here are in need, so all are eligible to receive our food and shelter." (Tất cả mọi người ở đây đều đang cần giúp đỡ, vì vậy tất cả đều đủ điều kiện nhận thức ăn và nơi ở của chúng ta).

questions.content: When the monks grumbled, what did the young monk speculate would happen if more families arrived?
options: They wouldn't make it through the winter
questions.explanation: Theo đoạn 5, vị sư trẻ suy đoán: "If more families come, we won’t make it through the winter" (Nếu có thêm nhiều gia đình đến, chúng ta sẽ không thể sống sót qua mùa đông).

questions.content: Why did the monks fast and sleep in the churchyard that adjoined the cathedral?
options: So that the families would have enough food and shelter
questions.explanation: Dựa vào đoạn 8, trụ trì quyết định "We will fast... we will give our rooms in the abbey to those sleeping outside, and we will sleep in the churchyard that adjoins the cathedral" để các gia đình có đủ thức ăn và chỗ ở.

questions.content: What was the oath that the monks had taken?
options: To help those that need help
questions.explanation: Trong đoạn 6, vị trụ trì nhắc lại lời thề: "We took an oath to help those that need help." (Chúng ta đã lập lời thề sẽ giúp đỡ những người cần giúp đỡ).

questions.content: What did the monks learn about helping others?
options: Sometimes it means giving more help than expected
questions.explanation: Đoạn cuối của câu chuyện kết luận: "They learned that sometimes helping others means you must give more help than you first expected." (Họ học được rằng đôi khi việc giúp đỡ người khác có nghĩa là bạn phải cho đi nhiều sự giúp đỡ hơn mức bạn mong đợi lúc đầu).
